info.title: Usage Metering & Quota Service
info.description: Tracks usage and decides whether users may consume units under an account plan and a user plan. Errors always look like `{ "error": { "code", "message", "details?" } }`.

post.summary: Create an account and issue its API key (admin only); idempotent with externalId
post.description: Requires `X-Admin-Token`. The `apiKey` in the response is shown once and never stored in plain form. If you pass `externalId` (your own id for the customer), creating it again returns the existing account with HTTP 200, `created: false` and `apiKey: null` instead of a duplicate; use the admin rotate endpoint if the first response was lost. Other fields only apply on first creation.

post.summary: Issue a new API key for an account (admin only; for a lost key)

get.summary: The calling account, its plan and limits

put.summary: Change the account's plan (usage is preserved)

post.summary: Issue a new API key; the old one stops working immediately
Register a user under the account

get.summary: Get a user and their plan

put.summary: Change a user's plan (usage is preserved)

get.summary: Predefined plans plus your custom plans

post.description: `null` for a limit means unlimited. Any number of users may share one plan; each keeps separate usage.

patch.summary: Edit a custom plan (applies to the next request)
patch.description: Partial update. Omitted fields are unchanged, `null` means unlimited. Predefined plans return 403.

post.summary: Consume units for a user if every account and user rule allows it
post.description: Always HTTP 200 for a decision: check `accepted`. A rejection consumes nothing. Retrying the same `requestId` returns the stored decision with `replayed: true`; the same id with a different user or amount is a 409.

get.summary: Account usage for a UTC month, with every user
get.description: Defaults to the current month. `remaining` is only reported for the current month (null for past months).

get.summary: One user's usage for a UTC month, plus the account they draw from
Plans and limits currently applied to a user and their account, with remaining units this month

get.description: Every decision, accepted or rejected, with the limits that applied when it was made. Cursor-paginated.
